mahoutsukai_ripper_effect_first.conversion: @ModifyVariable at the HEAD of TheRipper.ripperLivingTick: the parameter becomes null, so the handler's own opening null test ends it, when the shipped handler would do nothing: the entity lacks RIPPER_INVISIBILITY (LivingEntity.hasEffect with the same ModEffects holder EffectUtil.hasBuff passes; the hand-stack reads before that test are pure), or both its hands hold the Ripper (the shipped hand test ends it the same way). An entity found with the Ripper in both hands has its id remembered (a 64-slot open-addressing int set, home slot id & 63 with linear probing, so users sharing a home slot sit side by side: a hint for the order of the checks only), so the Ripper's own user is answered from two hand reads; with the effect and other hand items the parameter is unchanged and the handler runs as shipped. Runtime flag mahoutsukaiRipperEffectFirst. Helper bons.furious.patch.mahoutsukai_coo49.MahouTicks.
